HBO’s The Last of Us Season 3 has added John Goodman, Ian Alexander and Laura Bailey to its cast. 👀

Goodman will play Joey, Ian Alexander will play Paco, and Laura Bailey will portray Elizabeth, one of the Seraphite leaders.

The wild part? Alexander and Bailey are already very familiar to The Last of Us fans, they voiced Lev and Abby in The Last of Us Part II video game, but they’ll be playing completely different characters in the HBO series.

My take: This is such a fascinating move by HBO. Bringing back two actors who already helped define the game’s characters, but putting them in entirely new roles, could give longtime fans another layer to appreciate.

And John Goodman joining this world? I’m definitely curious to see what he brings.

Season 3 is expected in 2027.

SpaceX’s Starship flight 14 is launching 26 V3 Starlinks and represents ~26 Tbps for the launch (based on company specs)… at a very conservative cost estimate for Starship this puts Starships first operational launch at ~$9.8M per Tbps. Meaning in its first operational launch it nearly hits the same cost of Falcon9’s launch cost per Tbps. This is before full payload utilization, reusability and manufacturing learning rates kick in, which we expect to lead to 16x cheaper launch/Tbps cost by 2028.




Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt)

SpaceX has officially received regulatory approval from the FAA for Starship flight 14. Launch timeline is on track for this Monday.

This will be Starship's first revenue-generating flight, launching 26 V3 Starlink satellites into orbit for the first time.
